subject: feat(phase-3): Protocol replacement layer — SSH, Telnet, RDP, VNC, HTTP, PowerShell, Serial, ExternalApp
body:
feat(phase-3): Protocol replacement layer — SSH, Telnet, RDP, VNC, HTTP, PowerShell, Serial, ExternalApp

## mRemoteNG.Protocols (new project, net10.0)

### Abstractions
- IProtocol, IVisualProtocol, IProtocolFactory, ConnectionParameters, ConnectionState enums
- ProtocolBase: base class with Dispatcher-dispatched StateChanged/StatusMessage events
- ProtocolFactory: DI-based factory resolving all protocol types; ProtocolFactory.Register()

### SSH (SSH.NET)
- SshNetProtocol: password + public-key + keyboard-interactive auth; shell stream; keepalive
- TerminalView: custom VT100/xterm mini-parser + Avalonia canvas renderer; cursor; keyboard map
- SftpBrowserViewModel: directory navigation, download, upload stub, delete via SftpClient
- SshConfigImporter: parses ~/.ssh/config (Host, HostName, Port, User, IdentityFile, ProxyJump)

### Telnet / Rlogin
- TelnetProtocol: RFC 854 IAC option negotiation (ECHO, SGA, NAWS); TcpClient + NetworkStream
- RloginProtocol: RFC 1282 three-part handshake; bidirectional TerminalView I/O

### RDP
- RdpProtocol: FreeRDP subprocess (xfreerdp/wfreerdp); full arg builder (NLA, gateway, audio,
  clipboard, drive redirect, dynamic resolution); FindFreeRdpExecutable() PATH search
- WindowsRdpProtocol: [SupportedOSPlatform("windows")] MSTSCLib stub (Phase 4: COM interop)
- ADR-006 documented inline: subprocess+embed chosen over managed bindings

### VNC
- VncProtocol + VncView: MarcusW.VncClient architecture; WriteableBitmap frame rendering;
  keyboard/mouse forwarding stubs; focusable canvas with pointer events

### HTTP/HTTPS
- WebViewProtocol + WebBrowserView: address bar + navigation controls; platform-agnostic shell
  (Phase 4: WebView2/WebKitGtk/WKWebView backend)

### PowerShell
- PowerShellProtocol: spawns pwsh (falls back to powershell.exe); local + Enter-PSSession remote;
  TerminalView I/O; DataToSend → stdin forwarding

### Serial
- SerialProtocol: System.IO.Ports.SerialPort; configurable baud/data/parity/stop/handshake;
  cross-pla
